title: Rooting the ʿAqeedah: From Knowledge to Watchfulness
description: A path that roots the ʿaqeedah of your child (10–12) before bulūgh (puberty): from knowledge to watchfulness and conviction—faith-based identity, deep understanding of the arkān al-īmān (pillars of faith), ikhlāṣ (sincerity) and watchfulness, and riḍā bi-l-qadr (contentment with divine decree).

primary_reference.info: Thalathat al-Usul and al-Qawa'id al-Arba' by Muhammad ibn Abd al-Wahhab, with Ibn Uthaymin's commentary; al-Aqidah al-Tahawiyyah; As'ilat al-Atfal al-Imaniyyah; Usul al-Iman as understood by the Salaf
